measurement_condition: Determine experimentally or from validated structure assignment
interpretation: Required to interpret pKa and calculate ionization across GI pH
recommended_action: Do not run pKa risk rules until ionization type is known

measurement_condition: 25 C unless otherwise justified
rule_logic: For an acid: fraction ionized=1/(1+10^(pKa-pH)); for a base: fraction ionized=1/(1+10^(pH-pKa))
interpretation: pKa alone has no universal low/high-risk interval
recommended_action: Calculate fraction ionized at pH 1.2 4.5 and 6.8 and link it to measured solubility

measurement_condition: pH 1.2 4.5 and 6.8 using all relevant pKa values
rule_logic: Flag when predicted ionized fraction or measured solubility changes materially across GI pH
interpretation: Large pH response can produce site-dependent dissolution absorption or precipitation
recommended_action: Run biorelevant pH-shift and precipitation testing; evaluate salt and microenvironmental-pH strategies

measurement_condition: 37 +/- 1 C; equilibrium method; at least pH 1.2 4.5 6.8; minimum 3 replicates
rule_logic: Use the lowest adequately measured solubility within pH 1.2-6.8
interpretation: Single water-solubility value is insufficient for BCS classification
recommended_action: Generate equilibrium solubility profile and confirm API stability and final pH

measurement_condition: Use highest single therapeutic dose and minimum equilibrium solubility from pH 1.2-6.8 at 37 +/- 1 C
interpretation: BCS high solubility is dose-dependent
recommended_action: Calculate with traceable dose and solubility inputs

measurement_condition: ICH M9 conditions
interpretation: Meets the ICH M9 high-solubility boundary if study quality and stability requirements are satisfied
recommended_action: Combine with permeability to assign BCS class

measurement_condition: ICH M9 conditions
interpretation: Low solubility by ICH M9 at the evaluated highest single therapeutic dose
recommended_action: Determine DCS/rDCS limitation and evaluate dissolution or solubility-enabling strategies

measurement_condition: Unionized species; defined temperature and solid form
rule_logic: Measure or defensibly estimate intrinsic solubility
interpretation: Separates crystal-lattice effects from pH-ionization effects
recommended_action: Use with pKa melting/fusion data and pH-solubility profile

measurement_condition: Human pharmacokinetic data where applicable
interpretation: Supports high permeability for ICH M9 classification
recommended_action: Document data quality and combine with BCS solubility

measurement_condition: Human mass-balance evidence meeting ICH M9 conditions
interpretation: Supports high permeability when metabolite/recovery conditions are satisfied
recommended_action: Document recovery pathways and GI stability

measurement_condition: Prefer human PK; validated Caco-2 may support classification
rule_logic: Assign high only when ICH M9 evidence criteria are met
interpretation: Calculated descriptors or logP alone cannot establish BCS permeability
recommended_action: Generate appropriate human or validated in-vitro evidence

measurement_condition: ICH M9 solubility and permeability evidence
rule_logic: Class I=high S/high P; II=low S/high P; III=high S/low P; IV=low S/low P
interpretation: BCS class must not be inferred from water solubility or logP alone
recommended_action: Assign only after SOL and PERM rules pass data-quality checks

measurement_condition: Use intestinal/biorelevant solubility dose permeability dissolution rate and particle size
rule_logic: Class I: robust; IIa: dissolution-rate limited; IIb: solubility-limited; III: permeability-limited; IV: combined limitation
interpretation: DCS is a formulation-development framework rather than a single fixed threshold
recommended_action: Use validated DCS/rDCS implementation and retain calculated intermediate values

measurement_condition: DCS assessment identifies dissolution-rate limitation
rule_logic: High permeability plus low apparent solubility with absorbable dose recoverable by improved dissolution
interpretation: Particle-size reduction and wetting may be useful
recommended_action: Model target particle size and confirm dissolution/absorption; do not automatically require nanocrystals

measurement_condition: DCS assessment identifies solubility limitation
rule_logic: High permeability but solubility-limited absorbable dose below target dose
interpretation: Solubility-enabling formulation may be needed
recommended_action: Assess ASD salt/cocrystal lipid or complexation options using precipitation and stability data

measurement_condition: DSC with identity/purity and decomposition assessment
interpretation: Low-melting processing alert only; not a universal failure threshold
recommended_action: Assess softening sticking eutectic formation and process temperature before choosing manufacturing route

measurement_condition: DSC with identity/purity and decomposition assessment
interpretation: No universal low-risk claim can be made from this interval alone
recommended_action: Continue full solid-state solubility and mechanical characterization

measurement_condition: DSC with identity/purity and decomposition assessment
interpretation: Possible high-lattice-energy/low-solubility alert; does not establish poor compactibility or mandate ASD
recommended_action: Confirm intrinsic solubility enthalpy of fusion and crystal form before formulation selection

interpretation: Callahan Class I screening category
recommended_action: Standard moisture controls subject to stability and deliquescence data

interpretation: Callahan Class II screening category
recommended_action: Assess routine packaging using product-level stability data

interpretation: Callahan Class III screening category
recommended_action: Run DVS and moisture-stability studies; evaluate controlled humidity and protective packaging

measurement_condition: 25 C and 80% RH; report equilibration/time and initial water content
interpretation: Callahan Class IV screening category
recommended_action: Define humidity controls and packaging from DVS/deliquescence and product stability studies

measurement_condition: Validated method and dispersion state; report D10 D50 D90
rule_logic: Record PSD when it can affect dissolution content uniformity stability appearance or manufacturability
interpretation: PSD is a potential critical material attribute rather than a universal threshold
recommended_action: Link specification to product performance and process capability

measurement_condition: XRPD plus orthogonal thermal/spectroscopic methods as appropriate
rule_logic: Identify polymorph amorphous hydrate solvate and salt/cocrystal state
interpretation: Different forms can alter solubility stability flow and bioavailability
recommended_action: Select and control the intended form; assess conversion under processing and storage
evidence_basis: ICH Q6A and FDA polymorphism guidance

measurement_condition: Microscopy or imaging with representative batches
rule_logic: Assess needle plate block or irregular morphology and agglomeration
interpretation: Crystal habit can affect flow filtration compaction and dissolution
recommended_action: Link morphology to process and product performance before setting controls

measurement_condition: Compaction simulator or instrumented press under relevant conditions
rule_logic: Measure tensile strength as a function of compaction pressure
interpretation: Carr index and melting point cannot establish compactibility
recommended_action: Assess dilution potential lubricant sensitivity elastic recovery capping and sticking

measurement_condition: Relevant pH temperature light oxygen and time conditions
rule_logic: Characterize hydrolysis oxidation photolysis and other degradation pathways
interpretation: Solubility measurements are uninterpretable when substantial degradation occurs
recommended_action: Use stability-indicating analytics and separate dissolved intact API from degradants

measurement_condition: 37 C; representative gastric exposure 1 h and intestinal exposure 3 h when required
interpretation: Precludes the relevant ICH M9 high-permeability support pathway
recommended_action: Resolve instability or use appropriate human evidence

measurement_condition: Stress and long-term conditions appropriate to development phase
rule_logic: Assess heat humidity light oxygen and form conversion
interpretation: Stability risk cannot be inferred from hygroscopicity or melting point alone
recommended_action: Use stability-indicating methods and evaluate protective processing/packaging

measurement_condition: Gastric-to-intestinal pH shift in biorelevant media at dose-relevant concentration
rule_logic: Measure supersaturation duration precipitation rate and solid form
interpretation: Weak bases and other pH-dependent compounds may dissolve in stomach and precipitate in intestine
recommended_action: Evaluate precipitation inhibitors salt choice ASD or other enabling approaches only after measurement

measurement_condition: Defined medium temperature particle size and surface history
rule_logic: Measure wetting rather than inferring it from logP alone
interpretation: Poor wetting can limit apparent dissolution
recommended_action: Assess surfactant wetting agent or particle engineering using dissolution confirmation

measurement_condition: BET method with defined degassing conditions
rule_logic: Record surface area when particle engineering is used
interpretation: Surface area can affect dissolution adsorption moisture and reactivity
recommended_action: Link target range to dissolution and stability performance

measurement_condition: Mixtures and controls under justified stress with stability-indicating analysis
rule_logic: Assess chemical and physical interactions with candidate excipients
interpretation: Compatibility is formulation-specific and cannot be predicted from API thresholds alone
recommended_action: Confirm flagged interactions in realistic formulations and conditions

measurement_condition: Use pKa delta solubility crystallinity hygroscopicity and stability evidence
rule_logic: Salt feasibility is not determined by pKa alone
interpretation: A salt may improve handling or dissolution but can disproportionate or precipitate
recommended_action: Screen counterions and free-form conversion under GI/process conditions

measurement_condition: Use drug-product stability moisture permeability and use conditions
rule_logic: Do not assign foil-foil/desiccant solely from API hygroscopicity class
interpretation: Packaging requirement is a product-level decision
recommended_action: Select package using stability studies and moisture-vapor transmission modeling where appropriate

measurement_condition: Integrate dose solubility permeability precipitation solid-state stability and manufacturability
rule_logic: No single descriptor automatically mandates ASD SEDDS nanocrystal salt or granulation
interpretation: Formulation recommendations must be conditional and evidence-linked
recommended_action: Rank options using compound-specific experiments and a target product profile
